name: AWS Lambda
description: Invoke Lambda functions and manage configuration, versions, aliases, concurrency, policies, layers and tags with signed AWS API requests.

permissions.description: Signed HTTPS requests only to region-specific AWS Lambda API. Optional sessionTokenSecret and alternate credential references require corresponding host secret authorization. Exact confirmation for external actions; no automatic retries.

definitions.name: Lambda List Functions
definitions.description: Lambda List Functions
definitions.documentation: Lambda List Functions. GET /2015-03-31/functions. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListFunctions.html

definitions.name: Lambda Update Configuration
definitions.description: Lambda Update Configuration
definitions.documentation: Lambda Update Configuration. PUT /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/configuration. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CONFIGURATION_UPDATE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateFunctionConfiguration.html

definitions.name: Lambda Update Code from S3
definitions.description: Lambda Update Code from S3
definitions.documentation: Lambda Update Code from S3. PUT /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/code. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CODE_UPDATE_S3. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateFunctionCode.html

definitions.description: Lambda Create Function from S3
definitions.documentation: Lambda Create Function from S3. POST /2015-03-31/functions. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=FUNCTION_CREATE_S3. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_CreateFunction.html

definitions.name: Lambda Update Code from Image
definitions.description: Lambda Update Code from Image
definitions.documentation: Lambda Update Code from Image. PUT /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/code. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=CODE_UPDATE_IMAGE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_UpdateFunctionCode.html

definitions.name: Lambda Invoke Synchronously
definitions.description: Lambda Invoke Synchronously
definitions.documentation: Lambda Invoke Synchronously. POST /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/invocations. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=INVOKE_SYNC. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_Invoke.html

definitions.description: Lambda List Versions
definitions.documentation: Lambda List Versions. GET /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/versions. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListVersionsByFunction.html

definitions.documentation: Lambda List Aliases. GET /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/aliases. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListAliases.html

definitions.name: Lambda Create Alias
definitions.description: Lambda Create Alias
definitions.documentation: Lambda Create Alias. POST /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/aliases. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ALIAS_CREATE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_CreateAlias.html

definitions.name: Lambda Get Function Event Invoke Config
definitions.description: Lambda Get Function Event Invoke Config
definitions.documentation: Lambda Get Function Event Invoke Config. GET /2019-09-25/functions/{FunctionName}/event-invoke-config. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_GetFunctionEventInvokeConfig.html

definitions.name: Lambda Put Function Event Invoke Config
definitions.description: Lambda Put Function Event Invoke Config
definitions.documentation: Lambda Put Function Event Invoke Config. PUT /2019-09-25/functions/{FunctionName}/event-invoke-config. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=ASYNC_CONFIG_PUT. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_PutFunctionEventInvokeConfig.html

definitions.name: Lambda Get Reserved Concurrency
definitions.description: Lambda Get Reserved Concurrency
definitions.documentation: Lambda Get Reserved Concurrency. GET /2019-09-30/functions/{FunctionName}/concurrency. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. definitions.name: Lambda Remove Permission
definitions.description: Lambda Remove Permission
definitions.documentation: Lambda Remove Permission. DELETE /2015-03-31/functions/{FunctionName}/policy/{StatementId}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=PERMISSION_REMOVE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_RemovePermission.html

definitions.name: Lambda List Layers
definitions.description: Lambda List Layers
definitions.documentation: Lambda List Layers. GET /2018-10-31/layers. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_ListLayers.html

definitions.description: Lambda Add or Replace Tags
definitions.documentation: Lambda Add or Replace Tags. POST /2017-03-31/tags/{Resource}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=TAGS_PUT. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_TagResource.html

definitions.description: Lambda Remove Tags
definitions.documentation: Lambda Remove Tags. DELETE /2017-03-31/tags/{Resource}. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation=TAGS_DELETE. External action may commit before timeout; reconcile before rerunning. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. definitions.name: Lambda Get Account Settings
definitions.description: Lambda Get Account Settings
definitions.documentation: Lambda Get Account Settings. GET /2016-08-19/account-settings. Exactly one signed HTTPS request, no client/workflow retries or hidden polling. Invocation Event means accepted into AWS queue, not executed; AWS may retry or duplicate asynchronous events. RequestResponse returns bytes/base64 and function-error independently of HTTP status. Single page only; follow NextMarker deliberately. Update acceptance is not resource readiness; read State/LastUpdateStatus or provisioned Status. PUT async config replaces settings and removes omitted settings; POST updates selected settings. DeleteFunction without Qualifier deletes every version and alias. GetFunction excludes code download URLs and environment variables. GetLayerVersion excludes download URLs. Selected known fields only; optional absence/falsy values preserved; undocumented null rejected. 512 KiB request/invoke response and 1 MiB management response; 50 items/page; timeout 15 s default, 60 s max plus independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Node builtin crypto only, no dependency installation. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/api/API_GetAccountSettings.html
